Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 4  
Reason for Mistake: The first clear error was when WebSurfer chose to keep scrolling the article instead of extracting the paper link from the article’s bottom/reference area or using the visible clues more efficiently. This led to a prolonged loop of scrolling without identifying the actual paper. The conversation ultimately returned a NASA award number, but the agent’s inefficient and mistaken handling of the article navigation caused the wrong path and likely contributed to the incorrect final solution.
